observations: Photo 0 and 2 show a dark grey synthesizer keyboard with 'YAMAHA PSR-38' printed on the control panel.
Keys show visible yellowing and some discoloration, consistent with age/wear.
Control panel has multiple buttons (Voice Select, Accompaniment, Chord Sequencer, Auto Bass Chord) that appear physically intact.
The LCD/display area above the buttons is dark/unlit in all three photos; no readable screen content is visible.
No power cable, adapter, or battery compartment is shown in any photo.
Photo 2 shows the keyboard sitting in what looks like a storage/warehouse setting with other furniture in the background, keys photographed at an angle.
No video, audio, or close-up of the unit powered on is provided.

claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the unit powered on, display lit, or sound being produced; this cannot be confirmed from static photos alone.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or may have a faulty power switch/internal fault
risks.proof: A photo or short clip of the keyboard powered on with the display lit and a key being pressed producing sound

risks.risk: LCD screen may be cracked, dead, or showing no display even if the unit powers on
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lit LCD screen showing menu/voice selection text

risks.risk: Missing power adapter/cable required to operate the keyboard
risks.proof: Photo of the included power adapter alongside the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working (adapter missing, added cost to buyer)

risks.risk: Dead or unresponsive keys not visible from these angles
risks.proof: A clip sweeping across all keys being pressed with audible sound for each

risks.risk: Yellowing of keys suggests age; internal components (speakers, pitch wheel) may be degraded
risks.proof: Close-up of speaker grille and a clip testing volume/speaker output
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic wear with functional risk, worst case not working

proof_requests: A video clip of the keyboard powered on, showing the lit display and several keys being played with audible sound
A photo of the power adapter/cable included with the sale
A close-up of the LCD display showing normal operation (not blank/cracked)
A clip testing the volume slider and speaker output
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Yamaha PSR-38 keyboard from the panel photos, but the seller's 'tested working' claim is unverifiable from static images with no screen lit or sound demonstrated, so it must be priced at worst case as not working until proof is supplied.
